hits.draft_en:
Every time a new phone comes out, someone's website breaks on it. (h/t @marclou, iPhone Duo)

If you run a local business, pull your site up on the newest phone you can find. Can you see your number? Tap to call? Find what you do?

If not, that's the fix.

$150 to $400 an hour to blast rust off equipment. (h/t @mhp_guy)

I don’t like the iPhone Duo

1. It’s hard to open

It kept opening the camera because the button is right where my thumb needs to press to open the fold.

2. It’s cumbersome.

The folded mode is thick and large. It felt like holding a brick. The unfolded version is like an iPad. https://t.co/vMc2A6Lwdh

Clocks fall back Sunday, Nov 1. Good day to test your smoke alarms.

Press and hold the test button on each one. If one chirps, is over 10 years old, or doesn't sound, replace it.

Want them hardwired and linked? Call SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

A dimmer switch that buzzes or feels hot to the touch isn't normal.

It can mean the wrong dimmer for your bulbs or a loose connection behind the plate.

Turn it off and have a licensed electrician check it.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Got a standby generator? Don't wait for a freeze or an outage to find out it won't start.

A quick service check now covers the battery, oil, and transfer switch.

SoLit Electric installs and services generators in Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165
